notes:
## New
- Almost every coding setting in the CAFD editor now has a plain English explanation, and each one is true for every car series and module that uses the setting.
- The FDL-Editor's own "Search for" box finds settings by the names E-Sys MAX shows (for example HMI in the head unit), also after you open another coding file.
- Remote coding (Radmin VPN, Hamachi, ZeroTier, Tailscale, AnyDesk and other remote tools): fault scan, Module info, Restart module, battery voltage and backups go through E-Sys's own connection, so E-Sys keeps the car. About > Check car connection has a Remote car address box.
- Ignition status (KL15) next to the battery voltage: on, engine on or off.
- Fault scan explains many more faults.
## Better
- A licence you buy while E-Sys is open arrives by itself and is used right away, without starting E-Sys again.
- Fault scan, Saved lists, backups and the FDL-Editor stay smooth without freezing E-Sys.
- Code several changes goes on to the next module on E-Sys 24 too, and says clearly when a module may be coded in part.
- Pressing Code by hand while an E-Sys MAX job runs, or with an edit for another car still waiting, asks first.
- Clearing faults and token steps say "not sure" when no answer came back from the car.
- Updates arrive even when the website is down.
- Clearer messages on the licence screen, for required updates and in remote sessions.
## Fixed
- Many fixes in the fault scan, full backups, the vehicle order, cheat sheets, What to code for a feature, the FA editor and Settings.
- Problem reports leave out every login, password and PIN line.
- Small fixes.
